text: With the normalization of organizational change and the “multi-generational coexistence” of the labor market, understanding and mitigating employees’ resistance to change has become increasingly important. Based on a contextualized perceived human capital perspective, this study aimed to explore the associations among intergenerational mentoring characteristics, employees’ subjective appraisal of their career-related human capital, and organizational change receptivity.
source_label: An analysis of the association between workplace intergenerational mentoring characteristics and employees’ receptivity to change: the mediating role of contextualized human capital perception
